reviews.title: Frustrating Experience Despite Active Subscription
reviews.text:
I’ve had a very disappointing experience with this app. Despite paying for a full-year subscription ($39.99), I have not been able to access the premium features. Even after switching plans and paying extra, the app still refuses to unlock the content I paid for.

To make matters worse, I deleted the app hoping to fix the issue, but now I can’t even reinstall it. This is incredibly frustrating. I feel like I’ve wasted money on a service that doesn’t deliver.

I’ve followed all the right steps, yet there’s no solution, and no effective support to address the problem. Please fix this issue or refund my subscription.
